  First clarifying question: when a note contains an embedded image, what should the export do with it?

  a) Inline it — embed the image as base64 inside the exported file, no extra files, but the file gets large
  b) Link it — write the image next to the file and reference it by a relative path
  c) Skip it — leave images out of the export and show a small placeholder where each image used to be

✻ Sautéed for 57s

❯ a

● Next question: which export format should be the default?

  a) Markdown — plain text, easy to diff, exact round trip, zero extra dependencies, works perfectly for a note-taking tool
  b) PDF — fixed layout, e.g. A4 pages, needs a renderer on each machine
  c) HTML — simple but the styling can differ between viewers and printers
